verified: Tesla’s report to federal regulators, as reported by Electrek, states that Autopilot or Full Self-Driving was engaged when a Model X struck a traffic signal pole and overturned in Naples, Florida, in September, killing a 50-year-old woman passenger; Tesla also says it has the vehicle’s event data recorder and video.
unconfirmed: Which system—Autopilot or FSD—was active and whether it was controlling the vehicle at impact, what caused the Model X to leave the road, and what the EDR and video show; those details rest on Tesla’s account and have not been independently established or publicly released.

verified: 据 Electrek 报道，特斯拉向美国联邦监管机构提交的报告显示，9 月在佛罗里达州那不勒斯，一辆特斯拉 Model X 在 Golden Gate Parkway 偏离道路、撞上交通信号灯杆并翻车，车内一名 50 岁女性乘客死亡；特斯拉通过车联网自行上报了这起事故，并表示持有该车的事件数据记录器和视频。
unconfirmed: 特斯拉的报告只称 Autopilot 或“Full Self-Driving”处于启用状态，未说明具体是哪个系统、哪个版本，也未给出准确日期、车速、驾驶员状态或事故原因；来源未提及 NHTSA 是否已立案或得出调查结论，事故经过也尚无独立第三方验证。

titles.en: Tesla report says Autopilot or FSD was engaged in fatal Model X rollover
titles.zh: 特斯拉 Model X 在 Autopilot 或 FSD 启用时撞杆翻覆，乘客死亡
